name: claude-companion
description: Claude Code session and weekly usage in the status bar, color-coded by burn rate, with automatic session restart when the 5h window resets and automatic continuation of work the limit cut off

commands.title: Claude Companion: Start New Session Now
Claude Companion: Resume Interrupted Session Now

claudeCompanion.autoStartSession.enabled.markdownDescription: When the 5h session window expires, automatically send a minimal prompt to the `claude` CLI so a fresh window opens immediately. Costs one small turn against your weekly quota per reset, and anchors each new window to the moment the previous one expired.

claudeCompanion.autoStartSession.prompt.description: Prompt sent to start the new session. Keep it trivial: it is only there to open the window.

claudeCompanion.autoResume.enabled.markdownDescription: When a session in this workspace was cut off by the 5h limit, resume that same session once a fresh window opens so Claude continues the interrupted work. Takes the place of the `autoStartSession` ping for that reset.

enumDescriptions: Open the resumed session in a VS Code terminal, so you can watch it and answer permission prompts.
Run the resumed session in the background with `claude -p`. Nothing to watch, and tool calls needing permission are denied unless permissionMode allows them.
claudeCompanion.autoResume.mode.description: How the resumed session is launched.

claudeCompanion.autoResume.prompt.default: Your previous turn was cut off partway through because the 5-hour session limit was reached. Re-read the end of this conversation and continue that work from exactly where it stopped. Do not start anything new.
claudeCompanion.autoResume.prompt.description: Prompt sent to the resumed session. The conversation history is already there; this only tells Claude to carry on.

enumDescriptions: Auto-accept file edits; still ask for everything else.
Let Claude decide which tools it may run unprompted.
Skip every permission check. Unattended writes and commands, so use with care.
claudeCompanion.autoResume.permissionMod.markdownDescription: `--permission-mode` for the resumed session. In `headless` mode the normal setting cannot prompt you, so a resume that needs approvals will stall unless this is raised.
